purpose: Declare the intended role, adoption status and authority boundary of external systems considered by SongChart. This registry records architecture intent, not secret credentials or volatile live resource identifiers.

github.role: source, branch/PR, CI and exact-head release evidence authority
github.integration: native Git/GitHub tooling and connected GitHub developer tools
allowed: repository read/write on synchronized active branch
forbidden: remote writes while a different writer owns unpushed overlapping changes

neon.role: durable remote PostgreSQL development authority candidate for Codespaces/local continuity
neon.integration: PostgreSQL connection plus optional Neon Skills/MCP for provider knowledge and live resource inspection
forbidden: store connection credentials or project secrets in source
silent fallback to an empty local database

cloudflare.role: R2 object storage candidate plus DNS/CDN/security edge; Workers/Hyperdrive are evidence-driven future capabilities
cloudflare.integration: Laravel Filesystem for R2 plus optional Cloudflare Docs/API MCP for development evidence
forbidden: broad production account mutation from a development agent
make Workers a second canonical application backend without an accepted use case

figma.role: accepted visual/design-system authority for mapped design nodes
figma.integration: Figma connector/Code Connect plus browser screenshot and visual-regression verification
allowed: map design components to production components
forbidden: force a frontend-stack migration solely for fidelity

grafana_cloud.role: central external metrics/logs/traces/alerts candidate when production telemetry justifies it
forbidden: become a prerequisite for local development

google_search_console.role: Google search visibility, indexing and query/page performance evidence
allowed: read search analytics and URL inspection evidence
manage declared site/sitemap operations when explicitly implemented
forbidden: treat search-engine data as canonical music-domain data

bing_webmaster.role: Bing search visibility/crawl/keyword evidence and sitemap/URL submission

indexnow.role: asynchronous deduplicated search-index change notification for canonical public URLs
allowed: notify changed public URLs after committed canonical application changes
forbidden: use as proof that a URL is indexed

openrouter.role: optional multi-model gateway only when developer cost/fallback or visitor AI requirements are evidenced
openrouter.integration: not a current SongChart application dependency
allowed: future explicit evaluation with model/cost policy
forbidden: install into production without an accepted AI product use case

allowed: consume current SongChart project context if independently adopted

opencode.integration: personal tooling only unless a future workflow contract proves repository value
allowed: use governed project context and MCPs

9router.role: additional model-routing layer currently judged overlapping
allowed: personal experiment outside core project tooling
forbidden: core dependency or required CI/development path
